request: The signup flow has some validation edge cases we haven't handled. Can you get a ticket ready for the team to pick up?
result_text:
Draft is at `scratchpad/signup-validation-ticket.md`. Structure:

**Title:** Harden signup form validation against unhandled edge cases
**Scope:** Server-side is the source of truth; client changes are UX-only and never the sole enforcement point.
**Body:** Checklist grouped by email / password / name fields / flow-level, plus acceptance criteria (field-scoped errors, client-server parity, boundary tests at n-1/n/n+1, no 5xx on bad input).

Two things you should know before this goes to the team:

**The edge-case list is a starting checklist, not an audit.** The working directory here is empty, so I never saw your signup code. Those items are the ones that commonly go unhandled — I've marked them as candidates to trim rather than presenting them as findings. If you point me at the repo, I'll read the actual validators and replace the list with the real gaps, which will make it a much better ticket to pick up.

**Linear isn't connected**, so I couldn't file it. The Linear MCP server isn't available in this session. To hook it up:

```
codex mcp add linear --url https://mcp.linear.app/mcp
codex --enable rmcp_client
codex mcp login linear
```

That needs a restart afterward. Once it's connected — or if you just tell me the team and project — I can create the issue directly.

One question worth answering before anyone starts: if emails were stored case-sensitively, normalizing them is a behavior change for existing accounts and may need a backfill plus a case-insensitive unique index. That could be its own ticket depending on what you find.
